candidate.de: A 4-hour panoramic tour through Korčula's wine country aboard an open-top cabrio mini bus, visiting 3 family-owned wineries and tasting 10 local wines including Pošip and Grk — grape varieties unique to the island.
candidate.en: A 4-hour panoramic tour through Korčula's wine country aboard an open-top cabrio mini bus, visiting 3 family-owned wineries and tasting 10 local wines including Pošip and Grk — grape varieties unique to the island.
candidate.fr: Une visite panoramique de 4 heures à travers la région viticole de Korčula à bord d'un mini-bus cabrio ouvert, en visitant 3 caves familiales et en dégustant 10 vins locaux, notamment le Pošip et le Grk — variétés de raisin uniques à l'île.
candidate.hr: Panoramska 4-satna tura kroz vinogradarsku regiju Korčule na otvorenom mini autobusu, obilježavajući 3 obiteljske vinarije i okusajući 10 lokalnih vina, uključujući Pošip i Grk — sorte grožđa jedinstvene za otočje.
candidate.it: Una visita panoramica di 4 ore attraverso la regione viticola di Korčula a bordo di un mini-bus cabrio aperto, visitando 3 cantine familiari e degustando 10 vini locali, tra cui Pošip e Grk — varietà di uva uniche per l'isola.
candidate.sl: Panoramska 4-urna potovanja po vinogradniški regiji Korčule na odprtem mini autobusu, obiskovanje 3 družinskih vinogradi in okusovanje 10 lokalnih vin, med njimi Pošip in Grk — sorte grozdja, ki so enotvene za otočje.

candidate.de: Paddle through the sheltered waters of the Korcula archipelago and discover a 14th-century Franciscan monastery, free-roaming deer, and the ancient limestone quarry that built the walls of Dubrovnik — all in three hours, no experience required.
candidate.en: Paddle through the sheltered waters of the Korcula archipelago and discover a 14th-century Franciscan monastery, free-roaming deer, and the ancient limestone quarry that built the walls of Dubrovnik — all in three hours, no experience required.
candidate.fr: Paddler dans les eaux abritées de l'archipel de Korčula et découvrez un monastère franciscain du XIVe siècle, des cerfs en liberté et la carrière de calcaire ancienne qui a construit les murs de Dubrovnik — tout cela en trois heures, sans expérience nécessaire.
candidate.hr: Plovite kroz zaštićene vode Korčulskog arhipelaga i otkrijte 14. stoljećni franjevački samostan, slobodno trčiće jelene i staro kameno kamenolom, koji je izgradio zidine Dubrovnika — sve u tri sata, bez potrebe za iskustvom.
candidate.it: Paddlerai attraverso le acque protette dell'arcipelago di Korčula e scopri un monastero francescano del XIV secolo, cervi liberi e la carriera di calcestruzzo antica che ha costruito le mura di Dubrovnik — tutto in tre ore, senza esperienza necessaria.
candidate.sl: Plovite skozi zaščiteno vodo Korčulskih otokov in odkrijte 14. stoletni frančiški samostan, slobodno trčijo jelene in star kamnolom, ki so zgradili zidine Dubrovnika — vse v tri ure, brez potrebe po izkušnjah.
